narrative_purpose: The cold-open image: a single footstep on the forest floor sets off a spreading ring of bioluminescence, so the reader feels at once that on Pandora the dark answers with light — glow as the default, not the exception.
subject: A close view of a Na'vi foot pressing into dark forest moss, and radiating outward from the point of contact a bright ring of cyan-green light spreading through the ground cover; smaller answering glows rising from ferns and a fungal patch just beyond, fine luminous spores stirred up around the ankle.
scene: The forest floor at night, low to the ground, surrounding understorey falling away into glowing teal haze and deep shadow.
camera: A low, intimate ground-level angle close on the foot and the spreading ring of light, shallow depth into soft dark behind.
light: Bioluminescent key entirely from the moss ring and the touched ground; the foot and ankle lit from below by the glow they trigger; rich indigo shadow elsewhere.
palette: Void-indigo ground, intense Pandora cyan and living teal in the spreading ring, a faint magenta in stirred spores as a scarce warm accent.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted texture, tactile and observed.
detail_level: Crisp on the foot, the moss texture and the bright leading edge of the light ring; background dissolving into haze.
composition: The foot and contact point set just off-centre, the light ring as concentric arcs filling the lower frame, dark negative space above.
consistency_notes: Same cool Pandora palette and from-within bioluminescent key as the chapter cover; the moss-ring light should read as alive, not as a digital effect.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style
